subject: bia
title: BIA.-----MULT.INFO.
description: Chart on book p. 75 ((AF)D-3). BIA (bi-aitional) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; MULT-INFO is the partner, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of". From the subject: PRIN-INFO. From MULT-INFO: DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) and POST (postulation). From PRIN-INFO: MULT-INFO and CULT-INFO-F (culture information focus). From DYM-F: C-INFO (composite information) and EXPM (expansionism). From POST: C-ACT (composite activism). From C-ACT: AFI (affinity insight). From AFI: EXT-FT (extended functionalism). From EXT-FT: INFO-DE (information degrees), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of".
